message.content:
An editorial illustration in shades of purple, black, white, and red depicts a person walking into a forest. In the foreground and middle ground, dark, leafless, branching trees with jagged silhouettes frame a central clearing. The ground is a solid purple tone. In the center, a small figure wearing a conical hat and light-colored shirt walks away from the viewer, carrying a long-handled tool horizontally across their shoulders. A pale, round moon sits in the upper right sky.

Text at the top includes "TEMPO" in large white serif letters, with "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below. Above it, "Kamp Tahanan Politik 1965 H.72" and "Operator Jokowi Cawapres H.26" are printed on a dark blue background. A red rectangle is in the top left. The main headline reads "Para Penunggang Hutan Sosial" in large white serif font. Smaller text below states, "Relawan pendukung Jokowi dan perusahaan HTI menunggangi program perhutanan sosial guna mengeruk keuntungan. Pemulihan hutan tersendat. H.40". A red "T" logo with "INVESTIGASI" is on the left. The bottom contains a barcode, QR code, and "3-9 OKTOBER 2022 RP 50.000 MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN ISSN: 0126 - 4273".
